Csegold Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Dózsa György utca 18, Hungary

Not demolished. Csegöld's Jewish population grew from 10 residents among 777 total in 1880 to 21 by 1930, before falling back to just 10 individuals by 1941. This cemetery, most likely established as a Jewish section within the settlement's Christian cemetery after 1894, since it does not appear on that year's cadastral map, retains at least two preserved gravestones, one depicting a Star of David, though their inscriptions are illegible. After WWII, three houses that had originally belonged to Jewish families were sold to local residents.
